correctness.rationale: Explicit two-sided marked-Poisson construction identifies iid conditional Gaussian mixtures. Geometric thinning yields exact second and fourth marginal moments; independence conditional on clock yields pair covariance vq=q/(2-q). The environmental exponential perpetuity has rigorous L2 convergence and weighted-exponential CLT. An almost-sure geometric-kernel moment limit supplies conditional fourth-moment control and Lyapunov CLT. Conditional characteristic functions establish independent environmental and thermal limits. Exact rational stationary-generator, pair CF, variance, and cumulant checks corroborated critical algebra, not substituted for infinite-N proof.

value.rationale: The stationary mean-square radius has direct physical interpretation as gas width. Its nonselfaveraging exponential-perpetuity law for any fixed positive common-reset participation contrasts sharply with Gaussian independent-reset fluctuations. The exact covariance and fluctuation crossover at Nq comparable to one quantify when collective environmental noise competes with individual Brownian noise, distinguishing a natural intermediate resetting protocol not evaluated in inspected endpoints. The result is a structural limit-law classification, not a routine renaming or finite numerical exercise.
